title: Microbiome-derived bile acid signatures in early life and their association with islet autoimmunity
core_idea: Longitudinally profile microbially conjugated bile acids in infant stool to define their age-dependent trajectories, link those profiles to gut microbiome composition, and test how these conjugates modulate innate and adaptive immune responses in vitro to explore potential connections with development of islet autoimmunity.
tldr: The study tracks microbially conjugated bile acids across infancy (3–36 months), integrates targeted metabolomics and microbiome data, and uses immune cell assays to investigate whether early-life bile acid–microbiome interactions might be mechanistically relevant to islet autoimmunity risk.
